name: Orientation-Based Color Modification
definition: A technique to modify color, saturation, value, and transparency of volume samples based on the orientation of the gradient relative to the viewer, using HSV color space to simulate illustrative techniques like desaturation of facing surfaces.
summary: Orientation-Based Color Modification alters volume color and transparency based on the gradient-viewer angle to simulate medical illustration depth cues, differing from other methods by using gradient orientation rather than surface normals.
